vrbo-reviews 1.1.0

- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md, now includes detailed endpoint support by platform and clarifies required parameters for review queries.

- Documented known limitations including pagination, platform gaps, and usage of externally-sourced IDs.

- Removed redundant file (skill-card.md) for clarity and maintenance.
